kpis.signal: Leader in food quality among European retailers.

kpis.short: Private Brand No Artificial Flavor Enhancers

kpis.name: Share of recyclable plastic packaging

kpis.name: Share of recycled plastic in packaging

kpis.signal: 2025 target of 25 percent. Trajectory on track but ambitious.
